notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We have great news for you – Update 1.3 for Plot Twist is here! This version brings a variety of improvements, fixes, and tweaks to enhance your gaming experience.

🔧 What's new?
✨ Bug fixes that may have been causing issues in your gameplay.
🚀 Optimizations for smoother performance, even on lower-end PCs.
🏆 A better reward system and experience point distribution for faster progression.

And this is just the beginning! We're continuously working on further improvements and look forward to your feedback. If you encounter recurring issues, don't hesitate to reach out to us in the discussion forum!

🔄 Update the game now and enjoy the new version of Plot Twist to the fullest!

Thank you for your support! 💙

notes.title: Update 1.2 🎉
notes.notes:
Dear players, we are excited to announce the release of Update 1.2 for Plot Twist 🎮.

This update brings the following improvements:

[b]Mouse Sensitivity[/b] 🖱️: Based on your feedback, we have added the ability to adjust mouse sensitivity directly in the game, ensuring the most comfortable experience possible.

[b]Performance Optimization[/b] ⚡: We have made some minor tweaks and improvements that ensure smoother gameplay and better overall performance.

Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback 🙏. Your opinions are crucial for the ongoing improvement of Plot Twist. If you have any further suggestions or encounter any issues, feel free to contact us via the Steam forum 💬.

Enjoy the new update and continue your writer's journey! ✍️

Best regards,
The Sagittarius Fox Team 💫

notes.title: Update 1.1 – Improvements & Fixes!
notes.notes:
Dear authors,

We are bringing you Update 1.1 for Plot Twist, addressing your feedback and introducing a variety of changes, improvements, and fixes! 🎉

🔧 Major Fixes:

We have fixed a large number of bugs that were affecting gameplay.
Improved game stability and performance optimization.
⚖️ Balance Adjustments:

Some mechanics have been nerfed to ensure a fairer and more balanced experience.
Game progression has been adjusted to feel smoother and more enjoyable.
🛠️ Community Requests Fulfilled!

We've implemented a number of changes you asked for—thank you for your feedback!
Game elements have been redesigned for a better experience and deeper gameplay.
Upcoming changes in the following days:
Mouse sensitivity adjustments, bug fixes, and further optimization.

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to your feedback! ❤️

notes.title: 📢 Update 1.0 – Official Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
After months of development, it’s finally here – the full version of the game is out! 🚀 This final update brings tons of improvements:

✅ New rooms – 3 brand-new areas to expand your creativity!
✅ Fully revamped UI – better design, cleaner menus, and a smoother experience.
✅ Optimization & bug fixes – improved performance and no more crashes!
✅ Mini-games – new mechanics to make your progress more fun.
✅ Random events – unexpected situations that impact your development.
✅ New book options – even more genres and styles to create bestsellers.
✅ Development system (Skill tree) – strategically enhance your writing skills.

Thank you to everyone who supported the development – now it’s time to write literary history! ✍️📖🔥

Dear Players,

In our effort to bring you the best possible experience, we must announce that the release of our game Plot Twist has been postponed to a new date: [b]January 29, 2025[/b].

This decision was not easy, but we believe the wait will be worth it. Our goal is to deliver a high-quality, polished, and flawless product that meets your expectations and brings you the enjoyment you deserve. We are currently fine-tuning the final details to ensure the game is something you can be as proud of as we are.

Thank you for your patience and support – we truly appreciate it! Your excitement and trust drive us forward, and we can’t wait to experience this big Plot Twist with you.

Stay tuned for further updates, and if you have any questions or messages, don’t hesitate to reach out to us.

Thank you for understanding, and we’ll see you in January!

With love,
The Sagittarius Fox Team

notes.title: If Michelangelo Made Games
notes.notes:
Dear players, get ready for a real plot twist! 🌟
We present to you our biggest update yet, taking your favorite game to a whole new level!

What can you expect?
🔥 [b]Stunning graphical upgrades[/b]: Your favorite worlds have never looked this beautiful! New effects, textures, and details bring the game environment to life.
🎥 [b]An epic new trailer[/b]: Grab some popcorn and get ready for a dose of breathtaking scenes.
🎮 [b]Fresh content[/b]: New quests, locations, and surprises that will twist your journey even further.
👀 [b]Revamped user interface[/b]: Smooth, intuitive, and sleek – a joy to navigate.

This update is not just another chapter. It’s a leap forward that redefines Plot Twist as you know it. And trust us, you’ll want to be part of it!

[b]Thank you[/b] for your support and patience. Thanks to you, Plot Twist will become what it’s meant to be!

💬 We’re looking forward to your reactions, feedback, and especially to seeing how you enjoy this new gaming experience.
With love,
The Sagittarius Fox Team ❤️

notes.title: Update G
notes.notes:
🎉 Big News, [b]Plot Twisters[/b]! 🎉

We’ve got a plot twist of our own! 🚨 We are excited to announce the upcoming [b]G Update[/b], and it’s going to be a game-changer! 🕹️✨

🚀 [b]What’s new[/b]?

[list]
[*] Enhanced Graphics! We’ve polished every pixel, refreshed textures, and added a bit of magic to make the world of Plot Twist look even better! Get ready for a visual treat. 👀🌟

[*] Gameplay Enhancements! We’ve fine-tuned the mechanics to make the game smoother, more fun, and full of unexpected surprises! Even the gameplay got its own plot twist! 💡🎮
But that’s not all! We made sure this update not only improves your game but your gaming life as well. (Okay, maybe not life, but definitely your in-game life! 😜)
[/list]

Thank you for being such an amazing community! You’re the reason we keep pushing for bigger and better updates. Now, get ready for the grand release of Plot Twist!

Stay tuned for the most unexpected twist! This one you definitely didn’t see coming! 👀💥

We can't wait to see you,
Your Sagittarius Fox team 🚀🎉

notes.title: German and bugs
notes.notes: Hello! We've just released an update for our demo, the game is now fully translated into German, and we've also fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Czech & Slovak Games Week
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to announce that Plot Twist is part of Czech & Slovak Games Week on Steam! This special event celebrates the creativity and diversity of games from the Czech Republic and Slovakia, and we’re honored to be featured among them.

If you haven’t experienced Plot Twist yet, there’s no better time! Our latest demo update (version 0.8.0) introduces many exciting improvements, including:


[list]
[*] Extensive bug fixes for smoother gameplay
[*] Books now appear in your room's library as you create them 📚
[*] Book boxes disappear when books are sold 📦
[*] Major graphical enhancements and additional sounds for a richer experience 🎨🔊
[/list]

Dive into the writer's life, explore all its adventures, and see what awaits in the world of Plot Twist!


We’d also love to invite you to join our Discord community, where you can connect with other players and share feedback.

Thank you for your support of Plot Twist and Czech & Slovak games!

notes.title: Discord!
notes.notes: We now have an active Discord server! If you want to join and become part of the Sagi family or help us manage the Discord, feel free to join and reach out to us there or on our Instagram!

notes.title: 0.7.0 - Demoversion
notes.notes:
Today we’ve released a major demo update for our game, introducing numerous improvements and fixes:

[list]
[*] Complete redesign of the UI for a more thematic connection with the game’s content
[*] Faster access to your saved game from the main menu
[*] Added a clickable link to our Instagram for easier communication
[*] Expanded and clarified tutorials
[*] Reduced rewards for the bubble-catching minigame
[*] Fixed sound settings and added a test sound feature to check in-game volume
[/list]

notes.title: Next Fest
notes.notes: That's right, Plot Twist is participating in one of the biggest festivals on Steam – Next Fest! You can now try the free demo or add the game to your wishlist to help boost its visibility! Publish books, focus on quality, become famous!
